_comment: REAL SHAPE, observed 2026-08-22 on both live hubs. A smart breaker that has been enrolled with the hub but not yet located in the app ('Un-Positioned Breaker' in the Leviton UI, cleared with the positioning wizard) reports full electrical data with NO position key at all. aioleviton then substitutes 0 (models.py: position=data.get('position', 0)), which is how rows under the fiction 'breaker_p0' appeared for the 37 minutes between installing 20 breakers and finishing the wizard.
